failure_domain: one ERTS generation, its statically linked C, and all admitted BEAM code

trusted_inputs: root public key or digest policy

zones.authority: verify root artifacts, create and terminate runtime generations
execute one admitted ERTS generation in shared Wasm memory
perform only typed, granted, quota-bounded browser effects
mutate one owned DOM subtree using bounded semantic operations

attackers: memory corruption in ERTS or linked C

topology_candidates.runtime_entry: Emscripten shell proxies main to pthread Worker

allowed_shapes: offset and length into bounded snapshot
forbidden: raw ERTS pointer retained by host

quota_owners.policy: fixed initial and maximum for first proof
bounded count, cancel on dispose, stale completion rejection
per-capability limits and deny by default

patch_policy.boundary: small target/platform layer adjacent to upstream seams

stop_conditions: minimal boot requires broad POSIX emulation
Worker group cannot be fully terminated
resource slope remains positive after repeated disposal
loader admits unverified or mismatched code
required deployment cannot sustain secure-context and cross-origin isolation
contradiction_tests: no zone may both distrust a source and grant it unbounded authority
no imported power may bypass the capability broker
no topology candidate may become selected before measured evidence
no quota may lack a runtime owner
